name: @eetr/auth
description: OAuth 2.1 and OpenID Connect authorization server for Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build -c wrangler.generated.jsonc && SKIP_WRANGLER_CONFIG_CHECK=yes opennextjs-cloudflare deploy -c wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.upload: opennextjs-cloudflare build -c wrangler.generated.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare upload -c wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build -c wrangler.generated.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare preview -c wrangler.generated.jsonc
